product.title: Cortech X-Tray Insulated Food Tray - 3000
product.body_html:
The Cortech X-TRAY is an insulated food tray, TRUE One-Piece, seamless design with added features. The Tray has 5 compartments and 2 condiment compartments for bulk use (cost savings realized). It also has tongue and groove sealed compartments for superior temperature control (process patented), and a raised utensil slot for delivery convenience. The tray utilizes 2 top to bottom of the feeding surface; and ONLY weighs 1.75 lbs. The durability of the X-TRAY is that of our Rock Tray, plus these extra features. For your X-Treme Tray needs, the X-TRAY is your solution. The X-Tray is ideal for all correctional facilities, prisons, and jails.

  • X-TRAY is the LIGHTEST insulated food tray in the industry at just 1.75 lbs.
  • Tongue and groove patent pending design seals entire perimeter AND all individual compartments for the tightest seal available. Non-discriminatory in stacking!
  • Overall Dimension (14-1/4" x 9-1/2" x 2-1/4") 2" total food depth from top to bottom.
  • X-TRAYs patented one piece design features easy to eat from, easy to clean and easy to maintain correctional food tray.
  • Raised utensil slot for delivery convenience.
  • Highest Breakage Resistance Available. 1/4" minimum wall thickness.
  • X-TRAY is manufactured with FDA Approved insulated material, and is built to ISO Quality Standards.
  • Condiment cavities for bulk instead of individual portion packets. Cost Savings Realized.
  • Available colors: 3000C Chocolate Brown, 3000DG Dark Grey, 3000TC Terra Cotta, and 3000O Orange.
  • Packed 10 per case, must buy in full cases. Price is per case.

About Cortech USA by Correctional Technologies:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
